text: Every change to grain-ingest used to mean someone running Terraform and Helm by hand, in whatever order they remembered -- exactly how last lesson's NetworkPolicy slipped onto the cluster unreviewed.
Today we wire up a GitHub Actions pipeline. Every pull request runs helm lint, a schema check against the rendered manifest, and a Terraform plan -- before anyone even considers touching the cluster.
Only a merge to main can deploy, and even then it pauses for a human approval. Terraform applies first, then Helm upgrades, with state locked in Azure Storage so two applies can never race.
This pipeline catches a broken chart or a bad plan. It cannot yet catch two manifests whose labels silently disagree -- because the NetworkPolicy still isn't part of this chart at all.
That gap stays open for now. Next lesson adds the cost and reliability dashboard that ends up mattering far more than anyone expects.
